Hi Marco — really excited to run this. Quick scheduling note that might affect the join times: the US switched to DST on Sun Mar 8, while most of Europe (including Italy) doesn't switch until Mar 29. That means a 10:00 CET invite will show up as 05:00 EDT for our New York attendees.

Options to make this easier for everyone:
- Option A: move to 14:00 CET (09:00 EDT / 06:00 PDT / 21:00 SGT) — still within European daytime and early morning for US.
- Option B: keep 10:00 CET but offer a short repeat/recorded session for APAC later (we can record and share).
- Option C: split into two 30-min blocks (EU-focused + APAC/US-focused) if you want hands-on follow-ups.

We typically plan 45 minutes and will record. If you prefer Option A, we'll send a single calendar invite with explicit timezone labels (e.g., "14:00 CET / 09:00 EDT / 21:00 SGT").

Looping in Lauren and Monica to coordinate the calendar and the M&A doc.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
